revised_claim_text: The biopharma industry loses an estimated $35 billion annually from failures in temperature-controlled logistics — including lost product, clinical trial costs, wasted logistics spend, and root-cause analysis — per the 2018 Pharmaceutical Commerce Biopharma Cold Chain Sourcebook, as cited in the 2019 Biopharma Cold-Chain Logistics Survey commissioned by Peli BioThermal with IQVIA Institute as analytical partner. No independent 2023–2025 update to this figure has been published; flag for refresh.
